title: Payload fan-out grows with subscriber count
method: Synthetic workload: 2 events/s * 500 payload bytes * subscriber count / 1,000,000. Decimal MB/s excludes framing, TLS, brokers and retransmissions. Not measured service capacity.
alt: Payload fan-out grows with subscriber count. Illustrative values: 100 subscribers 0.1 MB/s, 1000 subscribers 1 MB/s, 5000 subscribers 5 MB/s.
